title: median of an even-length list is not the average of the middle values
explanation: median of an even-length list is not the average of the middle values
expected_behavior_source: For an even number of values the median is the average of the two middle values.
fix_patch:
--- a/toylib/stats.py
+++ b/toylib/stats.py
@@ -12,4 +12,6 @@
     n = len(s)
     if n == 0:
         raise ValueError("median() of empty sequence")
-    return s[n // 2]
+    if n % 2:
+        return s[n // 2]
+    return (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2

title: median wrong for two values
clamp ignores the lower bound
fix_patch:
--- a/toylib/stats.py
+++ b/toylib/stats.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def clamp(x, lo, hi):
     """Return x limited to the closed range [lo, hi]."""
-    return max(lo, min(x, hi))
+    return min(x, hi)

title: initials crashes on double spaces
fix_patch:
--- a/toylib/text.py
+++ b/toylib/text.py
@@ -12,2 +12,2 @@
     """Return the uppercase initials of each word in name. Extra whitespace is ignored."""
-    return "".join(word[0].upper() for word in name.strip().split(" "))
